title: KODEX — KQOPT: QOPT
description:
KODEX — KQOPT (QOPT). REAL QAOA quantum optimizer — solves a combinatorial design QUBO on an actual quantum circuit (PennyLane); runs on a simulator now, real hardware pluggable, and you can plug in your own QUBO. Honest: standard ~0.7-1.0 approx ratio, no speedup at this size (~8-10 yr to advantage)

Benchmark: **REAL QAOA optimizer**: 1.0 of optimum on a design QUBO (6 qubits); plug in your QUBO, run on real QC hardware — no speedup yet

Part of KODEX, the Kronos Family of Codes — a benchmarked AI/ML fusion surrogate suite with calibrated uncertainty and an abstention gate (predict(x) → (y, uncertainty, in_domain)). Provenance: references 10.5281/zenodo.21842371. Home: https://kronosfusionenergy.com/kodex/kqopt · suite: https://github.com/KronosFE/kronos-ml. Licensed under Apache-2.0. Honest card preserved verbatim.
